title: Naughty Neferata!16 Model variants!! NSFW 1.0.0
author: Dwjliel
description:
A NSFW Neferata Variant Selector mod!

Brings together 2 lovely Steam mods:

Neferata The Vampire Queen <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3809129102>

and

Beautiful Neferata <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3809988722>

Please go like and thumbs up those talented creators.

Breaks them up into 16 variants for you to play with til you find your favourite look, hat and Unit cards+Portrait combo, in accordance with your Vampire or Nagash faction Aesthetic preference.

For reference In game the numbers are:

1) Purple Vampy (NSFW)

2) SFW Beautiful

3) SFW Tomb Kingy

4) Vanilla (SFW)

5) thru 16) NSFW variations; if you think a couple are identical, check their weapons.

1 and 8 are my faves, I like a big hat!

Variant Selector Mod <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2888171970> on Steam is a soft requirment. Mod will load a NSFW skin by default without Variant Selector Mod <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2888171970>, but that mod enables functionality of choosing between 16 skins.

Similar mod for Elspetch Von Draken! <https://www.loverslab.com/files/file/41120-elspeth-2026-wombo-combo/>
